name: wa-hls4ml
description: A dataset and benchmark for estimating resource usage (e.g., LUTs, BRAM, DSPs) and performance of ML accelerators when mapping models to HLS/FPGA targets.
reputation: Moderately used within the HLS/FPGA research community for resource and performance prediction, but not a widely adopted public leaderboard.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark with small-to-moderate dataset size; reported metrics vary by target resource (LUT/BRAM/DSP) and performance measure; limited risk of public-contamination but heterogeneous task definitions make cross-model comparison nontrivial.
